entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Arcavios who founded Strixhaven; master of light and shadow through communication.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: Institution founded by the five dragons to study the mana dichotomies.

entities.name: Silverquill College
entities.description: Strixhaven college named in Shadrix's honor.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane formed when Ezroi and Karudis merged.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons hatched from mana vortices who founded Strixhaven.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: Seat of diplomacy founded by Shadrix in northeastern Arcavios.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: Era of violent clashes between warring armies, ended by a fragile peace.

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: Demiplane that merged to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: Demiplane that merged to form Arcavios.

events.summary: Over 7,000 years ago Ezroi and Karudis merge into Arcavios and five dragons hatch from luminous spheres of overlapping mana.
events.quote: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons .

events.summary: The dragons found Strixhaven, accepting that magic is safe only through disciplined study.
events.quote: So, centuries ago, the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

events.summary: After the Blood Age, Shadrix founds the Forum of Amity to preserve the peace.
events.quote: Shadrix Silverquill founded the Forum of Amity in the northeastern reaches of Arcavios as a seat of diplomacy

relations.quote: Shadrix Silverquill is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven .
Shadrix Silverquill founded the Forum of Amity
The Silverquill College is named in his honor.
